digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync command and reconciler engine
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing arbitrated plan entries with exact field-level drift detail, without invoking reconcile-check or duplicating comparison logic.
Canonical bridge preview must acquire, purge, steal, or write no pass lock; all collateral repository and reference state must remain unchanged and lock-free.

The engine argument parser must set allow_abbrev=False so undocumented prefix abbreviations (e.g. --dry-run as abbreviation of --dry-run-enumerate) fail with invocation error 2 before any store access, lock, or mutation, while documented options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and distinct output behavior unchanged.
Canonical bridge preview and canonical bridge sync must emit identical field-comparable manifest envelope structure; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally.

Legacy uncapped live callers through CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, and older workflows must retain historical tally/no-retained-manifest behavior; capped canonical sync and legacy bootstrap must preserve their existing deterministic applied/deferred contracts.
